Red Lions controlled most of the match, finishing with 69% possession, 85% of the territory share and 776 completed passes at 93% accuracy. Red Lions also pushed higher up the pitch, with 110 entries into the final third, while Blue Sharks had 31 and relied on fewer but sharper attacks, finishing with 5 big chances from 15 shots.

The key turning point was that Bell own goal, which gave Red Lions the last word after Blue Sharks had dragged the game back twice. The last 10 minutes were chaotic, but Red Lions had the heavier volume and the stronger control across the night, while Blue Sharks kept threatening whenever the game opened up.
